pricing.metaTitle: Pricing and Promos, Get Padel Jakarta
pricing.metaDescription: Hourly rates for Court 1 & Court 2 (weekday/weekend, peak & off-peak) plus running promos: Mandiri up to 20%, BRI 0%, Mayora snack, loyalty card, free trial, and junior classes.
pricing.title: Transparent rates, live promos.
pricing.subtitle: All rates are per 60-minute session and include 2 boxes of 240 ml mineral water. Booking & payment are processed via the official AYO channel.
pricing.rateSubtitle: Pick a day to view hourly rates. The "normal" column is the pre-discount price.
pricing.rateNoteFavorite: 18.00–22.00 on weekdays and almost every weekend slot are the favourite hours, and they fill up first.
pricing.rateNoteNonEvent: Rates apply to non-event use only. For events, tournaments, or commercial content, contact our team via email/WA.
pricing.promoSubtitle: Official promo posters straight from Instagram @get.padel & @racerallycoffee.
pricing.promoListSubtitle: Period, terms, and how to claim each promo.
pricing.bookingSubtitle: No registration, straight to the official AYO channel.
pricing.step1Body: Open the Schedule page and choose your favourite date and hour on Court 1 or Court 2.
pricing.step2Body: Hit "Book" and continue to the official AYO channel. No sign-up. The slot is held briefly, about 10 minutes, while you complete payment.
pricing.step3Body: Once payment succeeds, your booking confirmation is sent via email and/or the venue's official WhatsApp.
pricing.paymentSubtitle: Transactions are securely processed on the official AYO channel or directly at the venue.
pricing.paymentInstallmentNote: BRI 0% installments up to 12 months (min. Rp5 million) · Mandiri supports Power Installment & Livin' Poin redemption.
pricing.memberBody: Get Padel membership packages are only available through the AYO Indonesia app. Package prices and active vouchers are shown in the app. We don't display estimated prices.
pricing.ctaBody: Favourite slots fill up fast. Secure your schedule first.
pricing.refundRowRescheduleValue: Free, once only, up to 5 days before your slot.
pricing.refundRowMemberValue: Schedule changes with max. 3×24 hours notice before the play date (subject to court availability).
pricing.refundRowTechnicalValue: Slots are replaced subject to court availability. No cash refunds.
pricing.refundRowPracticeValue: The venue may offer a full same-day refund in certain cases (has happened before).
pricing.promoCodeSubtitle: A quick reference of promo periods and copyable details.
pricing.noCodeNote: Get Padel promos apply automatically via bank cards, events, or directly at the venue. Codes are only used when a promo has one.
pricing.carouselEmptyBody: The latest promo posters will appear here. In the meantime, check the promo list and terms below.
pricing.tierTitle: Pick the rate that fits your play time
pricing.tierSubtitle: All rates are per 60-minute session and already include 2 boxes of 240 ml mineral water, with no hidden fees.
pricing.tierIncludes: Booking and payment are processed on the official AYO channel. Transparent rates with no hidden admin fees.

pricing.tierFeature6: Bring your own outside coach at no extra cost

home.aboutBody: Two premium indoor padel courts for casual games, training and community sessions. Modern, welcoming to every level, with great air circulation and a comfortable waiting area.
home.aboutBody2: Warmly run by the venue team, with cold towels after play, air-conditioned bathrooms, racket rental (kids rackets included) and the Race & Rally coffee shop on site.

about.metaTitle: About Get Padel Jakarta, Indoor Padel Venue in Pondok Kelapa
about.metaDescription: Two premium indoor padel courts at the East Jakarta and Bekasi border, with Race & Rally coffee, full facilities, and a friendly community.
about.title: Get Padel, Get Well: run warmly by the venue team
about.intro: Get Padel Jakarta is a two-court indoor padel venue in Pondok Kelapa, Duren Sawit. We believe padel is more than scorelines: this place is built for casual games, serious practice, and a community that grows together.
about.storyTitle: The comfort we protect every day
about.storyBody: Indoor courts with certified premium turf, air-conditioned washrooms, a smoke-free area, and free cold towels after play. Outside coaches are welcome at no extra cost, and racket rental is complete, including kids' sizes.
about.facilitiesSubtitle: Everything you need before and after a game, from hot showers to Wi-Fi.
about.communityBody: From Chasing Sunset and Jamu Day to the Junior Summer Class, we host community events and brand collaborations all year. Got an idea? Our team is ready to help.
about.socialTitle: Latest from the courts & the coffee bar
about.socialSubtitle: Highlights from @get.padel and @racerallycoffee: sessions, promos, and community stories.
about.socialNote: Taken from the official Instagram archive as of 20 September 2026.

cafe.metaDescription: Coffee, coconut water, and refreshing drinks inside Get Padel Jakarta. Open daily 07:00–22:00, available on GoFood & GrabFood.
cafe.title: Get caffeinated & refreshed
cafe.subtitle: The coffee bar inside Get Padel Jakarta, your best company before the rally and after the match.
cafe.delivery: Available on GoFood & GrabFood, or right at the counter.
cafe.loyalty: 1 stamp per purchase of min. Rp30,000. The 10th one is a free drink.
cafe.menuBody: Coffee and refreshing drinks, with coconut water as a guest favourite. Two bottles of mineral water are already included with every court booking.
cafe.insideBody: The bar sits inside the venue. Grab a drink before your game, or drop by after you step off court. Smoke-free area.
